full_prompt_en: A square impasto landscape painting looks down a pale path as it enters a green valley beneath a blue sky. The paint is piled into long, directional ridges, making the terrain and atmosphere visibly physical rather than smooth. Across the upper half, broad ribbons of cool blue bend around small cream-white cloud forms; the clouds themselves are raised, rounded deposits of white and warm gray paint. Low green hills run inward from both sides toward a pale horizontal opening near the center. At the left edge, a dark upright mass of foliage anchors the foreground; another dark vertical group rises on the right, partly enclosing the valley. Between them, bands of moss green, olive, yellow, and muted turquoise sweep across the slopes. Small bright yellow patches punctuate the low vegetation, especially on the right and through the middle distance. The path begins wide and gray-beige at the lower center, narrows as it travels upward, and bends through the layered ground toward the distant pale band. Its surface is made of nearly parallel strokes that follow the road's direction, while the surrounding strokes curl and overlap more freely. The view remains broadly recognizable, yet edges are drawn by the thickness and direction of the paint rather than by fine linework. Light appears as clear daytime illumination from above: cream highlights gather on the clouds and yellow-green ridges, while dark green banks hold the heaviest shadows. The raised paint catches small real-looking highlights along its crests, making every turn of the brush or knife part of the scene's volume. The overall composition pulls the eye through a bright winding center, balancing lively textured ground with a spacious, flowing sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形厚涂风景画沿一条浅色小径望入绿谷，上方铺着蓝天。颜料堆成细长且有方向的脊纹，使地形与大气都具有可见的物质厚度，而非平滑色面。上半幅中，宽阔的冷蓝色带绕着小块奶油白云形弯曲；云本身由隆起的白色与暖灰色颜料构成。低矮绿丘从两侧向内延伸，在中央附近汇向一道浅色的水平开口。左缘一团直立的深色植被压住前景；右侧另有一组深色竖向形体升起，部分围拢山谷。其间，苔绿、橄榄绿、黄色和灰青色条带横扫坡地。细小亮黄斑块点缀低矮植被，尤其集中在右侧与中景。小径从下部中央宽阔的灰米色区域起步，向上延伸时变窄，弯过层层地面，通往远处的浅色横带。路面由近乎平行的笔触顺着道路方向构成，周围笔触则更自由地卷曲、交叠。景物大体仍可辨认，但边界由颜料的厚度与走向划出，而非细密线描。画面的光像从上方照下的清朗日光：奶油色高光聚在云层和黄绿色脊线上，深绿坡岸承接最重的阴影。隆起的颜料在脊顶捕捉细小而真实的亮点，使画笔或画刀的每一次转向都成为景物体积的一部分。整体构图把视线引过明亮蜿蜒的中心，在活跃的厚重地面与宽敞流动的天空之间保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: The oil-paint surface is built from conspicuously raised ridges, broad dragged ribbons, and shorter daubs that hold their shape. Cool blue and muted turquoise areas occupy a large open zone, while olive, moss, yellow-green, and small bright yellow accents gather in denser lower bands. Strokes follow the direction of the forms and curve around one another, so the texture organizes movement as well as describing surfaces. Edges are uneven, sometimes sharply cut by a ridge of thick pigment and sometimes blended where neighboring colors are dragged together. Cream highlights sit on raised peaks, and deeper green or blue furrows make the relief legible. Spatial depth comes from converging bands and a light central opening, yet the material thickness keeps the picture insistently near. The composition alternates broad, flowing sweeps with compact clusters of impasto, giving the image energetic rhythm and tactile weight.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表面由明显隆起的脊纹、宽阔的拖曳色带与保持形状的短促点涂构成。冷蓝与灰青色占据一大片开阔区域，橄榄绿、苔绿、黄绿与少量亮黄色重音则聚在较密集的下部条带。笔触顺着形体方向运行，并彼此环绕弯曲，因此肌理既组织运动，也交代物体表面。边缘并不齐整，有时被厚颜料脊线锐利切开，有时又因相邻颜色互相拖入而融合。奶油色高光落在隆起的峰顶，较深的绿蓝色凹槽使浮雕般的起伏可辨。空间深度来自汇聚的条带和中央浅色开口，而物质厚度又让画面始终贴近观看者。构图在宽广流动的扫笔与紧凑的厚涂团块之间交替，使图像具有有力的节奏和可触的重量。
theme_en: A winding path through a thickly painted green valley
theme_zh: 一条蜿蜒小径穿过厚涂的绿色山谷
name: Justin Gaffrey
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
